overall_goal: Prepare soup by adding water and stock, tidy the kitchen, and wash dishes

goals.description: Stir the vegetables and add hot water to the pot
goals.rationale: The person stirs the vegetables in the pot, then pours hot water from the kettle into the pot and stirs again.

goals.description: Add a stock cube to the pot and log its nutrition
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a stock cube, unwraps it, adds it to the pot, and writes down its nutrition information.

goals.description: Stir the pot to dissolve the stock cube
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to stir the contents of the pot to dissolve the newly added stock cube.

goals.description: Clean up a fallen piece of carrot
goals.rationale: The person notices a piece of carrot on the hob, moves a mug out of the way, picks up the carrot, and throws it in the food waste bin.

goals.description: Stir the contents of the pot
goals.rationale: The person picks up the spatula again and stirs the soup in the pot.

goals.description: Find a fitting lid, cover the pot, and adjust the heat
goals.rationale: The person searches through the cupboard for a lid that fits the pot, covers it, and lowers the heat to let it simmer.

goals.description: Put away the flour, a clean pot, and utensils
goals.rationale: The person tidies up by closing a bag of flour and putting away a clean pot, ladle, and strainer into their respective storage spaces.

goals.description: Put away the chicken stock, a clean pan, and tidy the countertop
goals.rationale: The person continues tidying by storing the chicken stock in the fridge, putting a clean pan in the cupboard, and moving a thermal flask.

goals.description: Prepare to wash dishes by putting on gloves and soaping the sponge
goals.rationale: The person puts on washing gloves, wets the sponge, and applies washing up liquid to it.
The person empties the soaking bowl, scrubs it with the soapy sponge, rinses it under hot water, and places it on the drainer.
The person rinses the tupperware, scrubs it with the sponge, rinses it again, and empties the water.
